name: Bump Chart (Rank over Time)
summary: How rankings change across periods or markets: one line per entity, #1 at the top, rank numbers in the nodes and names at both ends.
summary_zh: 展示排名随时间（或跨市场）的变化：每个主体一条线，第 1 名在最上方，节点内标注名次，两端直接标注名称。
description_zh: 适合联席顾问排行榜（今年 vs 去年）、业务板块 / 区域收入排名演变、各细分市场中竞争对手的位次对比等“名次比数值更重要”的场景。数据为长表：x（期间或市场）、series（主体）、value（数值，组件按期自动计算名次，rankOrder 控制大者优先或小者优先）或直接给 rank 字段；也支持宽表（encode.rank 为字段数组，如 ['prior_rank','rank']，每个字段是一期）。左侧按首期名次、右侧按末期名次列出名称（末期附数值），highlight 的主体以 accent-2 粗线突出、其余可自动置灰；top 可只显示前 N 名，主体进出前 N 时线条断开。
best_for: League tables: this year vs. last year
Segment / regional revenue rank over time
A competitor's position across several market segments
Any 'who moved up / down' story with 3–15 entities
avoid_when: Magnitudes matter more than order (use a line or slope chart of values)
More than ~15 entities or very frequent periods (lines tangle)
Ranks never change (use a ranked bar)

value.desc: Value used to compute ranks (or wide: one field per period); also shown in tooltip / right label

rank.desc: Pre-computed rank (1 = top); wide: one field per period, e.g. ['prior_rank', 'rank']

rankOrder.desc: When ranks are computed from value: 'desc' (largest = #1) | 'asc' (smallest = #1)

agg.desc: Aggregation when several rows share period + entity (sum | avg | max ...)

highlight.desc: Entity value(s) drawn in accent-2 with a heavier line

muted.desc: Grey out non-highlighted lines: 'auto' (when highlight is set) | true | false

top.desc: Show ranks 1..N only; lines break when an entity drops out

endLabels.desc: Entity names at both ends in rank order (left = first period, right = last period)

showValue.desc: Last-period value after the right-hand name (when values exist)

xLabels.desc: Override period labels (e.g. for wide rank fields)

sortX.desc: Sort periods ascending (long data); otherwise data order

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field's format

interactions: Axis tooltip: full ranking at that period with value and ▲/▼ change
Hover a line to isolate it
Click a line to cross-filter by entity
Lines draw in left-to-right; ranks re-animate when filters change
